items.title: GrayCharlie Injects Malicious JavaScript into WordPress Sites to Deliver NetSupport RAT and Stealc
items.description: A threat actor known as GrayCharlie has been compromising WordPress websites since mid-2023, silently embedding malicious JavaScript to push malware onto visiting users. The group overlaps with the previously tracked SmartApeSG cluster, also called ZPHP or HANEMONEY.
